notes: No amp+cab block — running into tube amp. Confirmed rig: Marshall ShredMaster (Ratatouille Dist approximation — both use similar op-amp/diode hard-clipping topology, ShredMaster Contour approximated by Filter parameter) into Marshall JCM800 2203 (Brit 2203 — removed per amp+cab policy) with Boss SD-1 (Stupor OD — confirmed key ingredient in Jonny's Bends-era tone). DigiTech Whammy WH-1 confirmed for solo — Poly Wham at +12 semitones (octave up) at 65% mix. Confirmed live: Jonny kicks on Whammy at 2:17 for squealing sustain of solo. Three snapshots: verse semi-clean, heavy riff, Whammy solo.

overdrive.notes: Confirmed Boss SD-1 used on The Bends era. Pre-distortion boost and tone shaper — pushes Ratatouille and adds mid-forward character. ACTIVE in Snapshots 1 and 2. BYPASSED in Snapshot 3 — solo tone uses Ratatouille alone for clearer, more defined character.

distortion.notes: ShredMaster approximation — both use op-amp gain stages with diode clipping. ShredMaster Contour control (mid scoop) approximated by Filter parameter. BYPASSED in Snapshot 1 (verse). ACTIVE in Snapshots 2 and 3. Note: Thom Yorke is a confirmed notable user of the RAT per YAML. Filter at 5.0 is neutral in S2; raised to 6.5 in S3 to give solo more sustaining character.

pitch.notes: Approximates DigiTech Whammy WH-1 — CONFIRMED Jonny kicks Whammy on at 2:17 in live performance for squealing solo sustain, octave up setting. Automatically assigned to EXP 1. Position 100 = full toe-down = constant octave up. Mix at 65% makes octave-up voice prominently audible. BYPASSED in Snapshots 1 and 2. ACTIVE in Snapshot 3 only. Tracking set to Fast for responsive pitch detection.

eq.notes: S1 gentle and open — verse not heavily sculpted. S2 tightens high cut to control JCM800 brightness under heavy distortion. S3 raises mid frequency to 1.0kHz with wider Q — broader boost supports Poly Wham octave-up voice. High Cut at 8kHz in S3 tames potential harshness of octave-up voice.

delay.notes: Confirmed Jonny used RE-201 since 1995, confirmed for The Bends era. Tempo-synced to 102 BPM. S1: eighth note = 294ms (original 320ms, 26ms off — using synced eighth). S2: sixteenth note = 147ms (original 160ms, 13ms off — synced). S3: eighth note = 294ms (original 280ms, 14ms off — synced). Treble rolled off in all snapshots to keep repeats dark.

reverb.notes: Dynamic Hall chosen for Radiohead presets — has Low Cut and High Cut parameters for better frequency control than Ganymede. NOTE: Room Size should NOT be assigned to snapshots — it changes the algorithm and causes an audible bump. Set Room Size as a fixed value.

1_verse.description: Verse / semi-clean. SD-1 only — no Ratatouille. Poly Wham bypassed. Gentle EQ, eighth note delay at 30% mix, moderate reverb. Not completely clean — controlled mid-forward OD character.

2_heavy_riff.description: Heavy riff. SD-1 boosting into Ratatouille — stacked ShredMaster approximation. Poly Wham bypassed. Very short sixteenth note delay (147ms) at 12% mix. Very dry reverb (0.6 sec, 10% mix). Maximum punch.

3_whammy_solo.description: Whammy solo. SD-1 bypassed — Ratatouille alone at Gain 7.0, Filter 6.5. Poly Wham active — Position 100, Toe Shift +12, Mix 65%. Octave-up voice prominent. EQ mid at 1.0kHz wider Q. Eighth note delay at 35% mix. High Cut at 8kHz to tame octave harshness.

playing_notes.pickup_notes: Bridge pickup throughout all three snapshots
playing_notes.technique: Verse requires firm deliberate picking — after recording The Bends Jonny developed arm pain requiring a brace, which tells you how hard he was playing. Full commitment to downstrokes on the riff.
playing_notes.snapshot_cues: Snapshot 1 for verse sections. Snapshot 2 for heavy riff sections. Snapshot 3 at exactly 2:17 in the live arrangement when Whammy engages — switch at this moment for maximum dramatic effect.
playing_notes.whammy_technique: Play solo as single notes only — Poly Wham tracks monophonically. Hold notes and let Whammy octave-up and Cosmos Echo sustain and bloom. Space and sustain are the tools — resist playing busily.
playing_notes.pre_chorus_technique: Verse sections (Snapshot 1) are not completely clean — there is a controlled mid-forward OD. Match this by picking with moderate force rather than trying to play softly into a clean tone.
